campaigns.context: Over 400 typosquat domains such as binancee2.com and biiousdt.com impersonate Binance for cryptocurrency fraud. Typedream.app and zapier.app subpages spoof Ledger, Trezor, and Bybit via wallet-setup paths, while vvtoken.top distributes a BINANCEPOOL.apk Android payload. Reporters phishunt_io and skocherhan flagged over 415 IOCs between 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Binance typosquat crypto scam on bin* domains

campaigns.context: AsyncRAT, CastleLoader, Sliver, and XWorm share infrastructure across DuckDNS, Dynuddns, and other DDNS providers, plus GitHub repos impersonating tools such as Make-MKV. Fourteen researchers reported 212 IOCs between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Multi-RAT C2 using DDNS and GitHub malware staging

campaigns.context: Multiple domains impersonate Zoom via /Windows/invite.php, /Zoom.us/Windows, and /images/ZoomInstaller.msi paths across .click, .im, .live, .us, .top, and .vn TLDs. A Google Meet lure on googlemeet0.pages.dev and interview-themed domains with /install-guide.php are also present. Multiple researchers reported over 118 combined IOCs between 2026-07-24 and 2026-08-18.
campaigns.name: Fake Zoom installer phishing via typosquat domains

campaigns.context: ClickFix and ClearFake lures on domains including fafaplaplapla.com and getpixeltap.com deliver CobaltStrike and stealer payloads. FakeCaptcha variants are present alongside log4j exploitation attempts. Thirteen researchers reported 113 IOCs between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-20.
campaigns.name: ClickFix malware delivery via getpixeltap.com

campaigns.context: Attackers abuse Pipedream and RequestBin developer HTTP platforms to create unique subdomains used as C2 or data-exfiltration endpoints. All Pipedream subdomains share a project prefix under m.pipedream.net and RequestBin endpoints share a single bucket ID. Reporters TheM3gatr0n and skocherhan flagged 102 combined IOCs between 2026-07-26 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Attacker abuse of Pipedream and RequestBin for C2 endpoints

campaigns.context: Kimsuky APT uses updatesourcetool.online and datupdatesourcetool.online as C2 on port 8443, backed by dynv6.net and dynu.net DDNS hostnames and .shop, .mom, and .store domains. Two SHA256 hashes are known. Five researchers reported 91 IOCs between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-18.
campaigns.name: DPRK-attributed C2 via updatesourcetool.online

campaigns.context: Sixty phishing domains use random 3+3 character subdomains on the mybluehost.me shared-hosting platform, suggesting automated subdomain creation on a compromised or free Bluehost account. The subdomain labels do not reference any recognizable brand, making the intended lure unclear. One researcher flagged 60 IOCs on 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: Phishing on mybluehost.me shared-hosting subdomains

campaigns.context: Phishing content is hosted under over 50 UUID-style subdomains on b-cdn.net, BunnyCDN's shared CDN domain, with /folders/index as a common path. The volume and automated naming pattern suggest attacker-controlled object storage or an abused CDN pull zone. Two researchers reported 52 IOCs between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: Phishing via BunnyCDN subdomain abuse on b-cdn.net

campaigns.context: Attackers distribute ScreenConnect installers via unauthorized tenant subdomains on screenconnect.com and dedicated domains such as tomballtxplumbers.com, with C2 listeners on ports 8040-8041 at mychap.co.uk and intfdt.com also serving the installer. Multiple researchers reported over 42 combined IOCs between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Unauthorized ScreenConnect RAT delivery via intfdt.com

campaigns.context: Thirty-eight phishing domains use business-named subdomains on posmasters.lk, a Sri Lankan domain consistent with a point-of-sale or hosting reseller platform. The labels reference apparent local businesses such as babyland and esrcafe, suggesting a compromised hosting account is being abused. One researcher flagged 38 IOCs on 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: Phishing on compromised posmasters.lk subdomains

campaigns.context: RemcosRAT C2 infrastructure uses DuckDNS hostnames such as careerlongprofit.duckdns.org alongside dedicated domains cinnamonthai.com and ygto.com. Executables are fetched via /cgi-bins/ paths with versioned filenames such as 05.08_8080_64.exe. Two researchers reported 31 IOCs between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: RemcosRAT C2 via DuckDNS and cgi-bins payload delivery

campaigns.context: Domains including vckvjn.asia, xcllgnb.cn, and raffinatoabito.com serve uniform /login pages, mixing Chinese-registered TLDs with generic .com and .asia hosts. Five researchers reported 28 IOCs between 2026-07-24 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Login-page phishing on Chinese .top and .cn domains

campaigns.context: Malvertising infrastructure includes tampareroofing.com, trekmesh15.com, aspen-92.com, and aspencore18.com, redirecting victims from malicious ads to infostealer payloads. Three researchers reported 28 IOCs between 2026-07-26 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Infostealer malvertising via tampareroofing.com

campaigns.context: C2 infrastructure at jpword.cc serves an agent configuration via /setup.pdf and exposes a panel on port 8383, while rukeyou.com stages ZIP and decoy JPG payloads under /sys/X2/. Supporting infrastructure includes a Cloudflare Pages host at hijndil-ownguen.pages.dev, a mail-themed domain w1mail.com, and a .zip TLD dropper. Reporters bomccss and tdatwja flagged 27 combined IOCs between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-20.
campaigns.name: Malware staging and C2 at jpword.cc and rukeyou.com

campaigns.context: An Android trojan campaign serves numbered APK variants from semprecardsecure.com under /variants/, with Pastebin for C2 config retrieval and ptnrmat.xyz as a secondary endpoint. A /police/ path suggests government-app impersonation. Six researchers reported 23 IOCs between 2026-07-24 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Android trojan APK distribution via semprecardsecure.com

campaigns.context: Multiple domains impersonate Trust Wallet via subdomain patterns such as trust-wallet, trustwallet, and claim-trust across walletsreward.com, claim-token-airdrop.info, 42web.io, and line.pm. Lures target victims with fake token-claim or airdrop pages. Four reporters flagged 22 combined IOCs between 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-16.
campaigns.name: Trust Wallet airdrop phishing on walletsreward.com

campaigns.context: studiotikva.com and allremdeskriki.com host C2 endpoints with /api/v1/agent/register and /api/v1/agent/ws paths consistent with a RAT or botnet panel. Duplicate domains dubl1allremriki.com and dubl2allremriki.com plus an IP on port 8899 suggest active failover infrastructure. Two researchers reported 14 IOCs between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: C2 agent infrastructure at studiotikva.com

campaigns.context: Spear-phishing download URLs on elementfx.com, scienceontheweb.net, mywebcommunity.org, and onlinewebshop.net pass [userdomain] and [username] template variables to /indown.php or /setting.php, enabling per-victim payload tracking. Reporters flagged 10 combined IOCs between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: APT spear-phishing download via elementfx.com

campaigns.context: Domains m081.com, ktmnos.com, julxi.com, and aikt888.com share a path pattern /Am2az-0ncO-jp-jp that obfuscates an Amazon reference with jp-jp locale identifiers, suggesting Amazon Japan is the impersonated target. Japanese-focused researchers masaomi346 and romonlyht reported 8 IOCs between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-20.
campaigns.name: Amazon Japan phishing via obfuscated /Am2az path

campaigns.context: Compromised legitimate domains including eastcoastwaterblasting.com, matakwan.com, and horusian.com share a nested /ngx(N)/ngx(N) directory path fingerprint consistent with a single phishing kit deployment. One researcher reported 8 IOCs between 2026-07-29 and 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: Phishing kit using /ngx(N) nested-path on compromised sites

campaigns.context: Phishing pages using 'aeon' as a subdomain on pvvjkwi.cn and dkoix.cn impersonate AEON, a major Japanese retailer. Hash-like URL paths such as /6crfgauf1c appear consistently across the cluster. Japanese-focused researcher Metemcyber reported 6 IOCs between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-18.
campaigns.name: AEON retail phishing on .cn and .info domains

campaigns.context: havan-com-br.site and havan-com.site clone the Brazilian retail chain Havan, serving fake product pages via /produto.php with Portuguese-language slugs. The domain pattern hyphenates the brand name with a country-code reference to appear legitimate. One reporter flagged 4 IOCs between 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: Havan retail clone phishing on havan-com-br.site

campaigns.context: A compromised jewellery retail domain, kharwadejewellers.com, hosts Hotmail credential-harvesting pages under long randomised subdomains that mimic Microsoft session tokens. One researcher reported 4 IOCs between 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-20.
campaigns.name: Hotmail credential phishing via kharwadejewellers.com

campaigns.context: fireblocksdocusign.icu combines Fireblocks and DocuSign brand names to lure crypto custody users via a fake e-signing page. Two reporters flagged 4 IOCs between 2026-07-27 and 2026-08-15.
campaigns.name: Fireblocks/DocuSign phishing lure on .icu domain
